text:
Emily (growth): quick experiment pitch — route high-intent inbound (trial signups that run >=1k tokens in first 24h) into a light 'prompt starter' flow inside the console + auto-grant a one-off 75 credit bonus when they finish the 3-step setup :zap:
Sanjay (growth-ops): love the idea. what's the primary metric? conversions -> paid? retention at day7? churn reduction?
Emily (growth): primary = trial->paid within 14 days. secondary = D7 active percentage and avg tokens/week. goal is 6% lift in trial->paid.
Ralph (analytics): define the cohort events so we can instrument. proposals: `signup.complete`, `first_request.timestamp`, `tokens_first_24h` (derived). Also we need a flag event `template_flow_started` and `template_flow_completed`.
Maria (product): product asks: is this purely UI funnel + credits, or do we need API-side routing too? can we just show a modal with templates or do we need a new onboarding route?
Liz (content): I can write two copy variants — one orientation-first (how-to templates) and one ROI-first (benchmarks + mini-case study). recommend we A/B them.
Joe (engineer): minimal infra: add a routing rule in the signup microservice to tag eligible users and call the campaign API to enqueue the credit. sample payload:
```
POST /campaigns/enqueue
{
  "user_id": "<id>",
  "campaign": "template_starter_v1",
  "grant_credits": 75,
  "trigger": "tokens_first_24h>=1000"
}
```
Joe (engineer): need to confirm rate limits for grants, idempotency key and audit log.
Sanjay (growth-ops): for tracking, we'll create two UTM+internal routing params: `utm_campaign=template_starter` + `route_variant=A|B`. Ralph can you wire the dashboards?
Ralph (analytics): yes — I'll add a funnel: `eligible -> started flow -> completed flow -> converted`. Also add cohort breakdown by `route_variant`. Need event names by EOD.
Liz (content): proposing copy snippets: Variant A headline: "Ship better outputs faster — starter prompts curated for your use case". Variant B headline: "See how teams cut prompt iteration time by 3x — try our starters (75 credits)"
Emily (growth): timing: soft launch to 10% of eligible for 2 weeks, then ramp if signal positive. Keep the credit grant budgeted to 1k users for the test.
Maria (product): small client-side modal + template carousel should work. I'll spec the modal and the `template_flow_started`/`completed` hooks. ETA for dev work?
Joe (engineer): 3 business days to add tagging + campaign enqueue. Modal will be an additional 4 days. We can parallelize.
Sanjay (growth-ops): I'll own rollout, experiment config and the 10% sampling. Also set rollback conditions: if support tickets increase >3x or cost per conversion > $120, pause.
campaign-bot: Campaign created: `template_starter_experiment` (id: camp_20260321_01) — sampling=10% — owner=@Sanjay — budget=75k credits. :white_check_mark:
Emily (growth): ok action items: Liz write A/B copy (due today), Maria spec modal (tomorrow), Joe infra + modal work (see timelines), Ralph dashboard events (EOD), Sanjay sets experiment config and slack alert for rollback.
Liz (content): I'll post the two variants in the content-review thread in ~2h for quick QA.
Ralph (analytics): ping me once events are live and I'll validate.
Emily (growth): thanks team — let's sync Thurs 9am to review early signal. :raised_hands:
Sanjay (growth-ops): noted. I'll add a calendar invite and the experiment doc to the marketing drive.
Joe (engineer): will drop a PR link once tagging is implemented.
Emily (growth): small one more ask — can we gate the credit grant to first-time usage of embeddings or chat? prefer to bias toward the flows we want to encourage. Joe/Maria, feasible?
Maria (product): yes we can add gating param `preferred_product_flow` in the campaign payload. I'll include in the spec.
Ralph (analytics): add `granted_credit_reason` dimension so we can segment outcomes by gating.
Emily (growth): perfect. wrapping up — excited to see if a small credits + templates nudge reduces time-to-value. :rocket:
